activity.title: Harbour office
activity.body:
“Harbour office.” The duty clerk reads it off the board:

Minato Ferry · Three sailings daily (town time)
In → Out
08:30 → 08:45
14:30 → 14:45
22:00 → 22:15

The ferry lies alongside the outer pier for 15 town minutes. Board by the gangway on the pier.
Next ferry in: 22:00 · in 90 town minutes

activity.title: Harbour Lights
activity.body:
The ferry’s horn across the water,
the lanterns lit along the quay —
I pour one more and tell the harbour
the things I never said to you.

Nao claps on the beat and gets it wrong on purpose, so you can’t hear that you did too.
